t: Suitable for inward and outward opening doors. Incorporates hardwearing draught excluder and sound barrier. Fitted with 30 minute intumescent 10 x 4mm fire and smoke seal, which can be removed and replaced if required. Easy access threshold for all flooring types, ideal for use in apartments, schools, hotels and public buildings. For certification, the selected door design must be independently tested or assessed.
